**[P2] Reject non-callable explicit plugins at initialization**

An old-style `plugins=[MyPlugin()]` value is returned without the callable check applied to entry points. Every invocation then catches the resulting `TypeError` in `_create_plugins` and continues without instrumentation, turning this breaking migration into repeated telemetry loss rather than a clear configuration failure. Validate every explicit entry here and raise `PluginLoadError` or `TypeError` before constructing the handler.
